decision: User 2026-11-01: Resume on a paused manual run starts it again (same as Back up now).
change: home-page.tsx: when the automatic pause is off and the WebDAV run is a paused manual run, Resume calls transfer.run(); otherwise resumeAutomatic() as before. Never both. IosLiveActivityStatus: a paused manual WebDAV run (without the automatic pause) maps to 'waiting', so the lock screen offers only Open.
firstAttempt: Calling resumeAutomatic() and then run() was tried on the Simulator: the manual run restarted (new run 0f99a1f4, 14 GET 200 on the server, ended needs_attention/review_required because the photos already exist), but the automatic run started at the same time failed with backup_busy (new run 0bb96303, needs_attention). Hence the never-both rule. The race between IosWebDavAutomaticCoordinator.begin()'s available() check and IosWebDavQueue.start() is pre-existing shared native code (Codex is editing these files) and was not changed.
